scope.name: Live Play Utilities, Rules, Handouts, and Media Control
scope.responsibility: Eliminate ordinary during-play tool switching through timers, dice/manual-roll entry, randomizers, map micro-utilities, handouts, audio control, user-owned rulebook/PDF access, contextual rules lookup, a campaign Rulings Ledger, progressive information density, and low-configuration common actions.
exit_criteria: Common live-play utility needs are native or one-step integrations.
Physical-dice tables are first-class rather than forced into digital rolling.
Dense rule/ability information can expose Full, Standard, or Essential projections where appropriate without altering canonical mechanics.
Common actions do not require users to understand specialist VTT configuration.
Heavy rendering/media libraries are not bundled into the mandatory client.
